interview_question: Explain the difference between composition and inheritance, and when you would prefer composition.
expected_answer: Inheritance establishes an 'is-a' relationship between classes, while composition establishes a 'has-a' relationship. Composition is generally preferred because it promotes loose coupling, prevents fragile base class issues, and allows dynamic behavior modification at runtime.
evaluation_criteria: Understanding of OOP principles, coupling, code maintainability, real-world trade-offs.
